strings.zh: 这里是１８号道路{NEWLINE}东　浅红市
strings.en: Rt. 18{NEWLINE}East to Fuchsia City

strings.zh: 我是「关东急速联盟」的老大,{NEWLINE}听我的小弟们说有个家伙{CLEAR}敢硬闯我们的地盘。{SCROLL}不过能一路走到这里,{NEWLINE}也算是挺厉害了。{CLEAR}我对你的实力很感兴趣,{CLEAR}让我亲自看看你够不够格{CLEAR}从我们的地盘通过！
strings.en: I’m the boss of the Kanto Speed{NEWLINE}Alliance. My boys tell me some punk had{CLEAR}the nerve to barge onto our turf.{SCROLL}Still, making it all the way here is{NEWLINE}pretty impressive.{SCROLL}I’m curious how strong you are. Let me{NEWLINE}see for myself if you’ve got what it{CLEAR}takes to cross our turf!
strings.notes: Route 18 end of the Kanto Speed Alliance arc (0348–0350). #3/#5 polite vs #6 firm player lines. Choices: #11 join / #12 stop hogging → #14 → #15 join / #16 → #17 → #18 agree / #19 → #20 (beat all members, then boss rematch #23/#24).

strings.zh: 是否接受挑战？
strings.en: Accept the challenge?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我现有非常急的事,{NEWLINE}没时间在这里跟你耽误。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I’ve got something really{NEWLINE}urgent to do. I don’t have time to{CLEAR}waste here with you.

strings.zh: 哦？什么事让你这么着急？
strings.en: Oh? What’s got you in such a hurry?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『浅红市的狩猎场{NEWLINE}有只精灵得了重病,{CLEAR}需要我去送药救命,{CLEAR}请你赶紧让开！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: A Pokémon at the Fuchsia City{NEWLINE}Safari Zone is seriously ill. I have to{CLEAR}deliver medicine to save it, so please{CLEAR}let me through!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『浅红市的狩猎场{NEWLINE}有只精灵得了重病,{CLEAR}需要我去送药救命,{CLEAR}你赶紧给我让开！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: A Pokémon at the Fuchsia City{NEWLINE}Safari Zone is seriously ill. I have to{CLEAR}deliver medicine to save it, so get out{CLEAR}of my way!

strings.zh: 为病重的精灵送药？{NEWLINE}那又怎么样！{CLEAR}从我们的地盘过,{CLEAR}想不打招呼就走可不行。
strings.en: Medicine for a sick Pokémon? So what!{NEWLINE}Nobody crosses our turf without paying{CLEAR}their respects first.

strings.zh: 哈哈,厉害厉害！以你的实力{NEWLINE}完全可以加入我们「关东急速联盟」。{SCROLL}我最喜欢的就是你们这些{NEWLINE}有真本事的训练家了,你过去吧！
strings.en: Ha ha, not bad, not bad! With skills like{NEWLINE}yours, you could easily join the Kanto{CLEAR}Speed Alliance.{SCROLL}What I like best is Trainers with real{NEWLINE}skill, like you. Go on through!

strings.zh: 你能打败我,很厉害嘛。{NEWLINE}我很欣赏你这样的强者,{CLEAR}以后有空常来我们自行车道玩啊。
strings.en: You beat me. Pretty impressive. I{NEWLINE}respect strong people like you. Come{CLEAR}hang out on our Cycling Road anytime.

strings.zh: 我很欣赏你这样的强者,{NEWLINE}怎么样,要不要考虑{CLEAR}加入我们关东急速联盟？
strings.en: I respect strong people like you. So{NEWLINE}how about it? Want to think about{CLEAR}joining the Kanto Speed Alliance?

strings.zh: 好啊,我早就想加入你们了
strings.en: Sure! I’ve wanted to join!

strings.zh: 你们不要再霸占自行车路了
strings.en: Stop hogging Cycling Road!

strings.zh: 哈哈哈哈,我果然没看错你,{NEWLINE}从此以后你就是我们的一员,{CLEAR}随便穿越自行车路{CLEAR}都不会再有人阻止你了。
strings.en: Ha ha ha ha! I knew I had you pegged{NEWLINE}right. From now on you’re one of us.{CLEAR}Nobody will ever stop you on the Cycling{CLEAR}Road again.

strings.zh: 你在开什么玩笑？{NEWLINE}把这里当作活动地盘是我们的自由！{CLEAR}谁也管不着！
strings.en: You kidding me? Using this place as our{NEWLINE}turf is our freedom! Nobody gets to{CLEAR}tell us what to do!

strings.zh: 没错,自由万岁,我要加入你们
strings.en: Long live freedom! I’m in!

strings.zh: 自由不是为所欲为
strings.en: Freedom isn’t anything goes

strings.zh: 你是说我的自由{NEWLINE}要受法律和公德约束？{CLEAR}受约束那还叫个屁的自由啊,{CLEAR}还让人怎么尽情去享受！
strings.en: You’re saying my freedom has to answer{NEWLINE}to the law and public decency? Freedom{CLEAR}with rules? What the hell kind of{CLEAR}freedom is that? How’s anyone supposed{CLEAR}to have any fun?!

strings.zh: 没错,受约束的那就不叫自由
strings.en: True, rules aren’t freedom

strings.zh: 那我也有阻止你们霸占道路的自由
strings.en: Then I’m free to stop you!

strings.zh: 对啊,你想做什么那是你的自由。{NEWLINE}至于你做不做得到,{CLEAR}就看你自己的本事了。{SCROLL}你要是能把我们「关东急速联盟」{NEWLINE}的全部成员击败,{CLEAR}我们就从此离开自行车道。
strings.en: Right. Whatever you want to do is your{NEWLINE}freedom. Whether you can pull it off{CLEAR}depends on your own skill.{SCROLL}If you can beat every member of the{NEWLINE}Kanto Speed Alliance, we’ll leave the{CLEAR}Cycling Road for good.

strings.zh: 在自行车之路上随意奔驰吧,{NEWLINE}这里是咱们「关东急速联盟」的天下！
strings.en: Ride the Cycling Road however you like!{NEWLINE}This place belongs to us, the Kanto{CLEAR}Speed Alliance!

strings.zh: 你要是能把我们「关东急速联盟」{NEWLINE}的全部成员击败,{CLEAR}我们就从此离开自行车道。
strings.en: If you can beat every member of the{NEWLINE}Kanto Speed Alliance, we’ll leave the{CLEAR}Cycling Road for good.

strings.zh: 居然击败了我的全部部下？{NEWLINE}好,那就让我亲自收拾你。{CLEAR}这次可不会像上次一样输给你了！
strings.en: You actually beat all my boys? Fine,{NEWLINE}then I’ll deal with you myself. I won’t{CLEAR}lose like last time!

strings.zh: 好吧,是你赢了,{NEWLINE}你用你的暴力夺走了我们的自由。{CLEAR}我们「关东急速联盟」{CLEAR}从此离开这里就是了。
strings.en: All right, you win. You took our freedom{NEWLINE}away with brute force. The Kanto Speed{CLEAR}Alliance will clear out of here, then.

strings.zh: 爽快！来打吧！
strings.en: Now that’s the spirit! Let’s battle!

strings.zh: 在这里能看到很广阔的海,{NEWLINE}就是被围栏挡住了有点可惜,{CLEAR}不能钓鱼了。
strings.en: You can see so much of the sea from{NEWLINE}here. Too bad the fence is in the way,{CLEAR}so no fishing.

strings.zh: 肯泰罗『Tau——ro！
strings.en: Tauros: Tau-ro!

strings.zh: 肯泰罗正在低头吃草。
strings.en: The Tauros is grazing with its head{NEWLINE}down.

strings.zh: 小火马『Poooo——ny！
strings.en: Ponyta: Poooo-ny!

strings.zh: 肯泰罗攻击过来了。
strings.en: The Tauros charged!

strings.zh: 富子『没想到肯泰罗会突然攻击人,{NEWLINE}你不要紧吧？
strings.en: Lara: I never thought the Tauros{NEWLINE}would suddenly attack someone. Are you{CLEAR}all right?

strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I’m fine. Not hurt at all.

strings.zh: 富子『肯泰罗现在正处在发情期,{NEWLINE}可能会比平时更有攻击性。{CLEAR}不过你却能轻松压制住肯泰罗,{CLEAR}真的是非常厉害呢。{SCROLL}富子『我是拉拉美族的作富子,{NEWLINE}你叫什么名字呢？
strings.en: Lara: The Tauros are in heat right now,{NEWLINE}so they can be more aggressive than{CLEAR}usual. But you brought it under control{CLEAR}with ease. That’s really impressive.{SCROLL}Lara: I’m Lara of the Laramie tribe.{NEWLINE}What’s your name?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我是来自真新镇的{VAR:0103:0}。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I’m {VAR:0103:0}, from Pallet Town.

strings.zh: 富子『{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}15号路正要举办对战马拉松比赛,{CLEAR}那是连续对阵不同对手的对战耐力赛,{CLEAR}得冠军的话还会有大奖哦。{SCROLL}富子『像你这么强的训练家{NEWLINE}如果能来的话一定很有意思。{CLEAR}怎么样,要不要来参加？
strings.en: Lara: {VAR:0103:0}, the battle marathon is{NEWLINE}about to be held on Route 15. It’s an{CLEAR}endurance contest where you face one{CLEAR}opponent after another, and the{CLEAR}champion wins a big prize.{SCROLL}Lara: It would be so much fun if a{NEWLINE}strong Trainer like you came. How about{CLEAR}it? Want to enter?

strings.zh: 富子『不要这么说嘛,{NEWLINE}对战马拉松是很有挑战性的比赛,{CLEAR}非常适合你这样强大的训练家。{CLEAR}怎么样,要不要来参加？
strings.en: Lara: Oh, don’t say that. The battle{NEWLINE}marathon is a real challenge, perfect{CLEAR}for a strong Trainer like you. How about{CLEAR}it? Want to enter?

strings.zh: 富子『太好了,{NEWLINE}我先去比赛场地等你咯。{CLEAR}一定要来啊。
strings.en: Lara: Great! I’ll go on ahead and wait{NEWLINE}for you at the venue. Be sure to come!

strings.zh: 富子『近几年来,我们拉拉美族{NEWLINE}一直在协助浅红市的护林员们{CLEAR}保护这一带的生态。{CLEAR}这附近的肯泰罗能这么有活力,{CLEAR}也有我的一份功劳哦。{SCROLL}富子『你如果也喜欢肯泰罗的话,{NEWLINE}可以去摸摸它们哦,它们很乖的。
strings.en: Lara: For the past few years, the{NEWLINE}Laramie tribe has been helping Fuchsia{CLEAR}City’s rangers protect the wildlife{CLEAR}around here. The Tauros here are this{CLEAR}lively partly thanks to me!{SCROLL}Lara: If you like Tauros too, go ahead{NEWLINE}and pet them. They’re very gentle.

strings.zh: 富子『肯泰罗！不要伤人！
strings.en: Lara: Tauros! Don’t hurt anyone!

strings.zh: 哼哼,我们「关东急速联盟」{NEWLINE}就是这条自行车道的主人！
strings.en: Heh heh. We, the Kanto Speed Alliance,{NEWLINE}are the masters of this Cycling Road!
